name: Hawk 20W
tagline: Newer brand open-frame 20W — competitive specs, unproven long-term support
tldr: Hawk enters the crowded 20W open-frame market with aggressive pricing and modern design. Specs look competitive on paper. Long-term reliability and community support are the open questions — treat as a calculated risk vs established Ortur/Sculpfun.
mainObjective: Budget 20W open-frame for makers willing to bet on a newer brand

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: Few independent reviews vs established models
beginnerNotes: Safer first-laser picks: Ortur LM3 or Sculpfun S30 Ultra. Choose Hawk only if price difference is significant and you accept support risk.
proTips: Document your settings and hardware mods — community knowledge base is still growing. Buy from seller with clear return window.
primaryUse: Budget 20W open-frame alternative for engraving and light cutting when established brands are priced out.
